newsitem.title: USA: Foster Wheeler wins $50 mln Qatar deals.
newsitem.headline: Foster Wheeler wins $50 mln Qatar deals.

text.p: Foster Wheeler Corp said Tuesday it has won contracts valued at about $50 million to supply and install two large direct-fired process heaters to Qatar Fuel Additives Corp.

The process heaters will be installed at Qatar Fuel's complex in Masaieed, formerly Umm Said, Qatar. The complex produces methanol and methyl tertiary butyl ether, both widely used fuel additivies, Foster Wheeler said.
The contracts will be completed by Alberta, Canada-based Foster Wheeler Fired Heaters Ltd. The project is scheduled for completion in mid-1999, it said.
